issues.rule: legibility: Read labels and captions at 1280x720 without zooming. Check size, contrast, overlap, and time on screen.
issues.saw: The 'refused rule_payto' floating label over the Basis Theory vault overlaps the top crossbar of the Spend policy gate and later collides with the yellow packet label at 00:17.
issues.expected: Floating labels should not overlap neighboring station geometry or moving labels.
issues.fix: Raise the Y offset or shift the X offset slightly to the right for the vault refusal label so it sits cleanly above the blue vault box without clipping the spend policy gate.

issues.rule: Beats per event kind: The vault shows a refusal mark (blue seal with a cross)
issues.saw: On refusal, the vault shows the floating label 'refused rule_payto', but no distinct 3D blue seal with a cross is visible on or above the vault.
issues.expected: A visible blue seal with a cross should appear at the vault when a payment is refused.
issues.fix: Add a clearly visible blue badge/seal mesh with a cross icon on the front or top of the vault when the refusal occurs.
